subject: Request: no-train commitment + evidence pack for CareLink POC
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <procurement@carelinkhealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <security@carelinkhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: no-train commitment + evidence pack for CareLink POC

Hi Neha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we move to finalize our pilot PO, Security and Procurement need a short, concrete set of commitments and evidence from Redwood before we can sign onboarding paperwork. High-level ask: a no-training (no-model-improvement) commitment for PII/PHI we send during the POC, plus an evidence package covering subprocessors, export paths, and proof of deletion for test artifacts.

Specific items we need by Aug 5:
- A one-paragraph no-train statement (can be DPA addendum) specific to the CareLink POC data set.
- Subprocessor inventory (names, roles, countries, and whether they have access to raw prompts).
- Export procedures for logs and data (SFTP or API), including whether we can request a full tenant export and the format.
- Evidence of controls: SOC2 section references or attestations if available; KMS handling (customer-managed or Redwood-managed options).
- If you allow derivative outputs to be used internally, we need to flag that. For this pilot we prefer no-derivatives outside our tenant.

Please let me know the right point people and expected timeline. We can loop in legal if needed — copying our counsel Priya and external counsel Maria.

Thanks,
Tom Ellis\Procurement Manager\CareLink Health

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Ellis <procurement@carelinkhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <security@carelinkhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: no-train commitment + evidence pack for CareLink POC

Tom — thanks for the clear list. We can meet the Aug 5 timeline for the pilot onboarding evidence. Im looping in Monica (ops owner) for the subprocessor inventory and export runbook, Rishi for DPA language, Laura for legal sign-off, and Connor for SFTP/runbook details.

High-level commitments were prepared to make for the POC:
- No-training/no-model-improvement on any PII/PHI or tenant-specific prompts for the duration of the pilot (we can add a short addendum to the DPA).
- Tenant-scoped derivative policy: Redwood will not use prompt/response outputs from your tenant for model improvement during the pilot; derivatives will be scoped to your tenant and deleted per retention schedule unless otherwise agreed.

We will produce an "evidence checklist" and a draft DPA addendum for your counsel to review by Aug 5. Monica — can you confirm the subprocessor inventory and whether we can produce the SFTP transfer procedure as an attachable stub? Connor — can you confirm if we can offer customer-managed KMS for this POC, or at minimum a documented encryption-at-rest/key segregation approach?

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min walk-through next week to go over the pack.

Best,
Neha Kapoor\Senior Manager, Trust & Privacy\Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <procurement@carelinkhealth.com>, Priya Shah <security@carelinkhealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: no-train commitment + evidence pack for CareLink POC

Neha/Tom — I can assemble the evidence checklist. Proposed items well include (attachment: evidence_checklist.csv):
- Subprocessor inventory (name / role / country / access level) — CSV and PDF export-ready.
- Network and export runbook (SFTP endpoint format, expected export payloads, transfer frequency) — Ill attach a short sftp-transfer-stub.txt showing field names and a sample manifest.
- Audit-log retention and example log export (how to request, format, timestamps).
- Proof-of-deletion process for temporary prompt stores used during the POC.
- High-level SOC2 references and our most recent report summary (redacted).

Connor — Ill need a plain-language SFTP step-by-step we can hand to your ops team. Ill plan to deliver the first pass of the checklist and SFTP stub by Friday (Jul 24).

Tom — will you accept a staged delivery (checklist + SFTP stub by Jul 24, legal DPA addendum and attestation by Aug 5)?

Thanks,
Monica Patel\Customer Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <procurement@carelinkhealth.com>, Maria Ross <maria.ross@healthlegal.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: no-train commitment + evidence pack for CareLink POC

Team — Draft DPA addendum language (placeholder; will redline):
"Redwood Inference agrees that for the duration of the CareLink Health Pilot (POC Deal CL-POC-2026-042), it shall not use, access for model training, or incorporate into model weights any prompts, files, outputs, or telemetry that are tagged as CareLink tenant data, nor derivative outputs that could be reasonably traced to such data, except with explicit written consent from CareLink Health."

Questions for ops: is our telemetry export (logs/kv cache dumps) separated by tenant and available for a one-time export? Also: can we provide a short attestation stating whether any subcontractor has access to raw prompt text or only to non-identifying telemetry? Monica/Connor — can you confirm by EOD? Ill prepare a redline for Laura to review.

- Rishi
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference (Contracts & Privacy)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <procurement@carelinkhealth.com>, Maria Ross <maria.ross@healthlegal.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: no-train commitment + evidence pack for CareLink POC

Rishi/Neha — the language looks good as a short addendum. Ive attached a redline (dpa-draft-redline.docx) with two clarifications:
1) Define "Pilot" duration or tie to a calendar end date or termination event;
2) Add a narrow exception for product safety/abuse monitoring where we may analyze aggregated telemetry that does not contain raw prompts or PHI.

On KMS: we can offer customer-managed keys in Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted POC, we provide key segregation and rotation procedures but not full customer KMS. Monica/Connor — include the KMS notes in the checklist so Tom knows the hosted vs private tradeoffs.

I will review the final checklist and the SFTP stub once Monica/Connor deliver. If CareLinks counsel (Maria) wants to propose alternate wording, please send redlines to me and Ill coordinate.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett\Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Ellis <procurement@carelinkhealth.com>, Priya Shah <security@carelinkhealth.com>, Maria Ross <maria.ross@healthlegal.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: no-train commitment + evidence pack for CareLink POC

Tom/Priya/Maria — following up with a concise summary and next steps. Attached: evidence_checklist.csv, sftp-transfer-stub.txt, initial DPA redline (dpa-draft-redline.docx).

Summary of commitments for the pilot (CL-POC-2026-042):
- No-training/no-model-improvement on CareLink tenant prompts/data for the duration of the agreed pilot (we will define the end date in the addendum).
- No use of tenant prompts/PHI for model improvement or weight updates without explicit written consent.
- We will produce the subprocessor inventory and a step-by-step SFTP export stub by Jul 24, and the legal addendum + attestation by Aug 5.
- Hosted POC: we provide key segregation and rotation; Dedicated/Private options can include customer-managed KMS (we can detail runbook).

Next steps:
- Monica to deliver checklist + SFTP stub by end of day Jul 24.
- Rishi and Laura to finalize DPA addendum and send to Maria for redlines by Aug 5.
- Connor to provide the export manifest example and confirm tenant-separated telemetry exports.

If acceptable, we can schedule a 30-minute call to walk through the pack next week — heres a suggested time: Mon Jul 27, 10:00 AM PT. Confirm and well send a calendar invite.

Thanks all,
Neha Kapoor\Senior Manager, Trust & Privacy\Redwood Inference
